Ok. My name is Emma Miller and I’m, my maid, mid, maiden name was Emma Swart and I come from Hungary and we lived in a little town in Hungary, the name is Bodrogkisfalud. He was in the, in a big city where he went to Hebrew and Hungarian school. He lived there for already—but he come home for vacation and summer vacation—but he was in that school already for five years because my father wanted him to have a better education, Hebrew and Hungarian. Yes, he was in a big city, Kosice. Kosice was in Czechoslovakia but later it became Hungary so they call it Kosice, it was a big city and we have some relatives there too so my mother figured it would be close to relatives and in a good school. My father begged him to come home March 19th when the Germans come in, they occupied Hungary, and my father begged him, "Come home, come home, be with us," and he said, "No, Daddy, I cannot go home. I have, they took me away at the ninth grade. I didn’t have a chance to finish ninth grade.
Yes, I was at the same city for a couple, for one year, only one year...

Yes, my father would teach us every night instead of having a tutor.
